decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the accepted success-modal button for separate random-referral finalization; no additional edit is required.
The accepted handling of an optional post-mint tip transaction does not change fiat buyers' access to commissions, tickets, prizes, or dashboard reward information.
The optional tip is initiated only after mint success as a separate transaction and does not change the ETH mint, swap, pricing, or refund flow.
The separate optional post-mint tip transaction does not alter the USDC approval or NFT mint flow.
The success-modal tip action does not change whether or how a wallet is provisioned for a fiat buyer.
The accepted optional tip UX occurs after mint success and does not change Transak payment conversion or automatic NFT mint behavior.
Because the tip is optional and sent through a separate user-initiated transaction, the $15 primary mint price and pricing commitment remain unchanged.
A separate optional tip is not part of the $15 primary-sale proceeds and does not alter the existing founder, affiliate, or prize-pool allocation.
The post-mint tip button does not enable, disable, or change the selectability of any mint payment method.
The optional tip transaction occurs only after a successful mint and does not change the NFT ebook product or unlimited primary-mint behavior.
The accepted success-modal action does not change mint payment-currency disclosure or selection between ETH and USDC.
The accepted modal UX does not necessarily require changing the supplied About-page copy; its reward-delivery statements can remain valid without describing the optional tipping transaction.
